verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs say it has built-in support for multiple social providers ('Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord, and more'), and its SSO plugin adds generic OIDC and OAuth2 providers. Community users report using the built-in Google, Apple and GitHub OAuth providers without writing special code. However, the evidence does not show the actual provider configuration syntax or a full provider list, so the 'broad set via configuration, not custom code' claim is only partly documented. missing for 10: documented socialProviders configuration example showing config-only setup, enumerated full provider list demonstrating breadth, independent hands-on corroboration of config-only setup for generic OAuth/OIDC providers

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer sign-in with a broad set of social and OAuth identity providers through configuration, not custom code

citations.quote: Better Auth supports multiple social providers, including Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord, and more.
This plugin supports OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth2 providers, and SAML 2.0.
Hundreds of auth features like OAuth providers (google, apple, github)
without writing a single line of special code
